summary: Full E2E test of SAHAYSETU (backend + Expo web preview at 1440x900 and 375x812). Backend: 16/16 pytest cases green covering health, JWT auth (login/register+OTP/verify/forgot+reset/gov-login/role/logout), 401 on missing+invalid token, 409 duplicate email, 400 bad OTP, dashboard summary (kpis: active_incidents=12, people_affected=2459, volunteers>=823, rescues=806, by_severity + recent), incidents list w/ severity+status+search filters, /incidents/{id} detail + 404, PATCH status, POST /updates, /map/markers (all 5 arrays populated with lat/lng), and no MongoDB _id leak. Frontend: splash auto-redirects to /login; seeded login arjun@sahaysetu.in/rescue123 lands on dashboard-screen with 4 KPI cards showing 12 / 2,459 / 823 / 806; Leaflet map renders in iframe with legend chips; Recent Incidents list clickable -> /incident/INC-1000 with all 5 tabs (Overview/Updates/Resources/Teams/Reports) and 5 action buttons; update-input+update-send posts timeline entry (verified new 'TEST_playwright_note' bubble); Incidents screen chip filters (High/Active) and incident-search='Flood' both filter list correctly; Live Map with all 5 layer toggles rendered (incidents/teams/resources/shelters/hospitals) plus Leaflet map; Settings theme-dark toggles whole app to dark and PERSISTS across nav-dashboard AND full page reload (verified via screenshot of dark dashboard); profile-screen and sos-screen render; sidebar-toggle collapses on desktop and opens mobile-drawer at 375x812. Register flow: reg-name/email/password -> otp?dev=944223 with otp-code auto-prefilled -> role-coordinator + role-confirm -> dashboard-screen (all in one shot). Forgot-password: fp-email/fp-send returned dev_code, fp-code prefilled, fp-newpw+fp-reset succeeded and returned to /login. gov-login button logged in as demo coordinator and reached dashboard. Split login screen (>=1280) renders left brand panel + right form. No React Native red screen. No deprecated Expo packages (expo-av/barcode-scanner/background-fetch) found. No page errors thrown during any run.
action_items: None blocking. Optional: after resetting a password via forgot-password, the app returns to /login where the user must re-enter the new password. Consider auto-logging them in or showing a success toast; current behavior is acceptable.

Optional: the incident PATCH endpoint accepts any status string (e.g. 'Monitoring') without validation - consider Enum('Active','Monitoring','Resolved') if strictness matters. Not a bug for demo scope.
Optional cosmetic: /login side panel uses full-height blue with white text - contrast is fine; no action needed.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py reads MONGO_URL/DB_NAME/JWT_SECRET via os.environ[...] (fail-fast) - correct.
get_current_user checks Emergent session_token first, then JWT - clean dual-auth path; missing/invalid token both correctly return 401.
public_user() strips password_hash and _id fields before returning - no PII/mongo _id leaks observed anywhere.
OTP hashed via bcrypt with per-record salt; expiry enforced; ttl index on otps.expires_at auto-cleans - solid.
login endpoint runs check_pw against a bogus hash when user not found, which mitigates user-enumeration timing (nice touch).
Dashboard/incidents/map endpoints all Depends(get_current_user) - auth-gated as required.
Frontend uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL via src/api.ts (correct Expo web contract).

All interactive elements exposed correct testIDs (login-*, reg-*, otp-*, role-*, fp-*, kpi-*, chip-*, incident-*, tab-*, act-*, update-*, layer-*, nav-*, theme-*, sidebar-toggle, mobile-drawer) - testing was frictionless.
Leaflet map is rendered via web-only LeafletMap.web.tsx inside an iframe; container + markers render fine on headless preview.
Theme persists via AsyncStorage (verified across full page reload).
